system.description:
These enhanced versions of flashbangs release a concussive blast and a cloud of rubber “stingballs” designed to stun targets and knock them off their feet. This blast also releases a blinding flash and a deafening thunderclap. Treat as a shock effect ▶219.

Stun seekers/grenades can also be set into “overload mode,” inflicting an all-out sensory assault for a full minute. In addition to blinding glare, the device releases nausea-inducing malodorants and infrasonic frequencies that trigger unpleasant emotional responses (anxiety, uneasiness, extreme sorrow, revulsion, and fear).
